description: Logical calls of programmable DC power supplies. channel_number is 1-based; the library selects the output (steps) or maps it to the instrument's own identifier.

bool.description: true/false; default text sent to the instrument is ON/OFF unless the library gives a map

channel_number.description: output/channel number (1-based); ignored by single-output supplies
output/channel number (1-based); ignored by single-output supplies
output/channel number (1-based); ignored by single-output supplies
output/channel number (1-based); ignored by single-output supplies

output_on.description: enable the output(s) (all outputs of the instrument)

output_off.description: disable the output(s) (all outputs of the instrument)

error_query.description: read and clear the oldest error

channel_number.description: output/channel number (1-based); ignored by single-output supplies

select_channel.description: select the output addressed by the following commands (low level; set_voltage etc. already select it)

select_channel_numeric.description: select the output by number (low level)

select_channel_named.description: select the output by name (low level)

apply.description: select an output and set voltage and current together

apply_voltage.description: set the voltage of all channels without changing the selected channel; values is a comma separated list "CH1[,CH2[,CH3]]" (series-specific)

apply_current.description: set the current of all channels without changing the selected channel; values is a comma separated list "CH1[,CH2[,CH3]]" (series-specific)

read_voltage_all.description: read the voltage measured on the output terminals of all channels (series-specific)

read_current_all.description: read the current measured on the output terminals of all channels (series-specific)

set_channel_outputs.description: enable/disable the output of each channel without changing the selected channel; states is "CH1,CH2,CH3" with 1/0 or ON/OFF (series-specific)

set_track_mode.description: enable/disable track mode of CH1 and CH2 (triple output models only) (series-specific)

set_series_mode.description: enable/disable series mode of CH1 and CH2 (triple output models only) (series-specific)

set_parallel_mode.description: enable/disable parallel mode of CH1 and CH2 (triple output models only) (series-specific)

set_ovp_level.description: overvoltage protection (OVP) value of the selected channel (series-specific)

set_ocp_level.description: overcurrent protection (OCP) value of the selected channel (series-specific)

set_ovp_level_all.description: OVP value of all channels; values is "CH1[,CH2[,CH3]]" (series-specific)

set_ocp_level_all.description: OCP value of all channels; values is "CH1[,CH2[,CH3]]" (series-specific)

enable_ocp.description: enable overcurrent protection on the selected channel (series-specific)

disable_ocp.description: disable overcurrent protection on the selected channel (series-specific)

query_ovp_tripped.description: 1 if the overvoltage protection has tripped on the selected channel (series-specific)

query_ocp_tripped.description: 1 if the overcurrent protection has tripped on the selected channel (series-specific)

clear_protection.description: clear tripped protections (OVP/OCP/OTP) on all outputs (series-specific)

save_state.description: store the instrument state in a memory location (0-9) (series-specific)

recall_state.description: recall the instrument state from a memory location (0-9) (series-specific)

set_remote_lock.description: remote mode with front panel local button disabled (local lockout) (series-specific)

set_triggered_voltage.description: program pending triggered voltage level, transferred to output on trigger (series-specific)

set_triggered_current.description: program pending triggered current level, transferred to output on trigger (series-specific)

set_coupling.description: couple triggered levels between logical outputs (list of output identifiers) (series-specific)

initiate_trigger.description: initiate the trigger system (transfers triggered levels) (series-specific)

set_trigger_delay.description: delay between trigger detection and output change, 0..3600 s (bus trigger source only) (series-specific)

trigger_bus.description: generate a bus trigger (IEEE-488 GET); over RS-232 requires SYSTem:REMote (series-specific)

operation_complete.description: set Operation Complete bit (bit 0) of Standard Event register when pending operations complete (series-specific)

wait_to_complete.description: wait for all pending operations to complete before executing further commands (series-specific)

enable_event_status_register.description: enable bits in the Standard Event enable register (series-specific)

set_service_request_enable.description: enable bits in the Status Byte enable register for SRQ generation (series-specific)

set_power_on_status_clear.description: power-on status clear: 1 clears enable masks at power-on, 0 preserves them (series-specific)

set_display_state.description: turn front-panel display off or on (series-specific)

display_text.description: display a message on the front panel (up to 12 characters) (series-specific)

clear_display_text.description: clear the message displayed on the front panel (series-specific)

query_scpi_version.description: query SCPI language version, returns string YYYY.V (series-specific)

set_local_mode.description: return to local mode over RS-232 (GPIB uses GTL/Local key instead) (series-specific)

set_remote_mode.description: place in remote mode over RS-232 (must be sent before RS-232 programming) (series-specific)

query_questionable_status.description: query Questionable Status event register (bit 4=FAN, bit 13=ISUM); also clears it (series-specific)

enable_questionable_status.description: enable bits in Questionable Status enable register (series-specific)

query_questionable_instrument_status.description: query Questionable Instrument event register (bit 1=+6V, bit 2=+25V, bit 3=-25V overload) (series-specific)

query_instrument_summary.description: query Questionable Instrument ISUM event register for one output (bit 0=voltage unregulated, bit 1=current unregulated) (series-specific)

query_instrument_summary_condition.description: query CV/CC operating condition of one output: 0=off/unregulated, 1=CC, 2=CV, 3=hardware failure (series-specific)

enable_instrument_summary.description: set Questionable Instrument ISUM enable register for one output (series-specific)

calibration_count_query.description: query number of times the unit has been calibrated (series-specific)

calibration_voltage_data.description: enter voltage value read from external meter for calibration (requires unsecured state) (series-specific)

calibration_voltage_level.description: select voltage calibration point (MIN must be entered first, then MAX) (series-specific)

calibration_current_data.description: enter current value read from external meter for calibration (requires unsecured state) (series-specific)

calibration_current_level.description: select current calibration point (MIN must be entered first, then MAX) (series-specific)
